entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Diana. How can I help you today?
Yeah, this VeloBand Pulse you sold me is a complete piece of junk. I want to return it right now. It's totally broken.

I'm very sorry to hear you're having trouble with your device. I can definitely look into this for you. To make sure I understand correctly, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or a matter of preference?
A technical fault? It's defective! The entire thing is not working. I've charged it for hours, and it still won't sync with my phone or the app. It's useless.

Okay, thank you for clarifying. It sounds incredibly frustrating when a new device won't sync up properly. Just to confirm for my notes, you're saying the band is not working at all and seems to be defective?
Yes! That's what I've been saying. It's a broken product and I want my money back. I've had it for a little over two weeks. Just process the refund.

I understand you're looking for a refund. Based on what you're describing, because it's a technical issue, the correct path is to get you to our Tech Support team. They're equipped to troubleshoot the syncing problem and can determine if the unit is defective.

No! I am not getting passed around to another department! This is ridiculous. I want a refund, not a lecture. Are you refusing to do your job? Get me your manager right now. I'm about to leave a review about this on every single website.

I can assure you I'm doing everything I can to resolve this. I understand you don't want another transfer, but our policy for a defective device after the first 10 days is a warranty claim, which Tech Support handles. They are the only ones who can authorize an immediate replacement for you. A refund isn't an option at day 16, but getting you a brand new, working device is. I can transfer you directly, and there's no queue. They'll solve this for you.
Ugh, fine. No queue, you promise? If they waste my time, I'm calling back and I'm only speaking to a manager.
I promise. They are the fastest path to a solution. I'm confident they'll get this sorted out. Please hold for just a moment while I connect you.
